original_coverage_E: Tanzania — Dar es Salaam, Pwani, Tanga, Lindi and Mtwara regions plus all five Zanzibar regions (Unguja and Pemba)
coverage_T: Tanzania (Dar es Salaam [entire ADM1], Pwani [entire ADM1], Tanga [entire ADM1], Lindi [entire ADM1], Mtwara [entire ADM1], Zanzibar North [entire ADM1], Zanzibar South & Central [entire ADM1], Zanzibar Urban/West [entire ADM1], North Pemba [entire ADM1], South Pemba [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Zanzibar moved here from seat 333; Tanga, Lindi, Mtwara added; renamed.
notes: Tanzania ADM1 = 30 regions in geoBoundaries (2015 vintage: Songwe is not separate, it sits inside Mbeya; Zanzibar = 5 regions named 'Zanzibar North', 'Zanzibar South & Central', 'Zanzibar Urban/West', 'North Pemba', 'South Pemba'); no ADM2 needed. Pop = 2022 census by region (Songwe+Mbeya combined) scaled to 72.4m (old-sheet WPP basis; mainland+Zanzibar). Swahili-coast seat; contiguous mainland coast (Tanga–Pwani–Dar–Lindi–Mtwara); Zanzibar/Pemba linked to Dar by established ferry crossings (short sea links).

coverage_T: Tanzania (Singida [entire ADM1], Tabora [entire ADM1], Shinyanga [entire ADM1], Geita [entire ADM1], Kagera [entire ADM1], Kigoma [entire ADM1])

original_coverage_E: Kenya — Nairobi, Kiambu, Murang'a, Nyandarua, Nyeri, Kirinyaga, Embu, Tharaka-Nithi and Meru counties
coverage_T: Kenya (Nairobi [entire ADM1], Kiambu [entire ADM1], Murang'a [entire ADM1], Nyandarua [entire ADM1], Nyeri [entire ADM1], Kirinyaga [entire ADM1], Embu [entire ADM1], Tharaka [entire ADM1], Meru [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Nairobi seat merged with the Mount Kenya counties (Kikuyu/Embu/Meru heartland); Machakos & Kajiado moved out.
notes: Kenya ADM1 = 47 counties (geoBoundaries; 'Tharaka' = Tharaka-Nithi); ADM2 sub-counties not needed. Pop = 2019 census by county scaled to 58.8m (old-sheet WPP basis). Contiguous Nairobi-Kiambu-Murang'a-Nyeri-Meru; Gikuyu/Embu/Meru (GEMA) block plus the capital.

original_coverage_E: Kenya — Mombasa, Kwale, Kilifi, Tana River, Lamu, Taita Taveta, Garissa, Wajir, Mandera, Marsabit, Isiolo, Kitui, Machakos and Makueni counties
coverage_T: Kenya (Mombasa [entire ADM1], Kwale [entire ADM1], Kilifi [entire ADM1], Tana River [entire ADM1], Lamu [entire ADM1], Taita Taveta [entire ADM1], Garissa [entire ADM1], Wajir [entire ADM1], Mandera [entire ADM1], Marsabit [entire ADM1], Isiolo [entire ADM1], Kitui [entire ADM1], Machakos [entire ADM1], Makueni [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Old 'Mount Kenya' seat redistributed (Mount Kenya counties now in 336); this seat is now the Coast + Lower Eastern + North Eastern/frontier seat; renamed.
notes: Kenya ADM1 = 47 counties (geoBoundaries; 'Tharaka' = Tharaka-Nithi); ADM2 sub-counties not needed. Pop = 2019 census by county scaled to 58.8m (old-sheet WPP basis). Culturally the least homogeneous Kenyan seat (Swahili coast, Kamba, Somali/Cushitic north) - forced by the 4-seat constraint and contiguity.

coverage_T: Kenya (Nakuru [entire ADM1], Uasin Gishu [entire ADM1], Trans Nzoia [entire ADM1], Elgeyo-Marakwet [entire ADM1], Nandi [entire ADM1], Baringo [entire ADM1], Kericho [entire ADM1], Bomet [entire ADM1], Narok [entire ADM1], West Pokot [entire ADM1], Turkana [entire ADM1], Samburu [entire ADM1], Laikipia [entire ADM1], Kajiado [entire ADM1])

notes: Kenya ADM1 = 47 counties (geoBoundaries; 'Tharaka' = Tharaka-Nithi); ADM2 sub-counties not needed. Pop = 2019 census by county scaled to 58.8m (old-sheet WPP basis). Former Rift Valley Province (Kalenjin, Maasai, Turkana, Pokot, Samburu, Nakuru cosmopolitan); contiguous.

original_coverage_E: Uganda — whole Central Region (Kampala, Wakiso, all of Buganda) plus the Busoga counties of Eastern Region
coverage_T: Uganda (Central Region [entire ADM1], Eastern Region (Budiope, Bugabula, Bugweri, Bukooli, Bulamogi, Bunya, Busiki, Butembe, Buzaaya, Kagoma, Kigulu, Luuka ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Redrawn: Kampala-Wakiso + Buganda + Busoga merged into one seat (old Buganda-Busoga seat absorbed); renamed.
notes: Uganda in geoBoundaries: ADM1 = 4 regions (Central, Eastern, Northern, Western); ADM2 = 151 old counties (NOT districts); 'Mukono' and 'Soroti' each occur as two distinct ADM2 units and both are included wherever the name is listed. Pop = UBOS 2024 census sub-region totals (Buganda+Kampala, Busoga, Bukedi, Elgon, Teso, Lango, Acholi, Karamoja, Ankole, Bunyoro, Tooro, Rwenzori, Kigezi, West Nile, Madi) assigned to counties by sub-region and scaled to 52.8m (old-sheet WPP basis). Pop = Buganda 11.17m + Kampala 1.80m + Busoga 4.36m (2024 census) scaled x1.150. Busoga is adjacent to Buganda via Jinja/Buikwe and Buvuma and is historically linked to Buganda. At 19.9m this is the largest seat in the group (inside band).

original_coverage_E: Uganda — Eastern Region except Busoga (Bukedi, Bugisu, Sebei, Teso) plus Northern Region counties of Lango, Acholi and Karamoja
coverage_T: Uganda (Eastern Region (Amuria, Bubulo, Budadiri, Budaka, Bukedea, Bulambuli, Bungokho, Bunyole, Butebo, Kaberamaido, Kalaki, Kasilo, Kibuku, Kongasis, Kumi, Kween, Manjiya, Ngora, Pallisa, Samia-Bugwe, Serere, Soroti, Tingey, Tororo, Usuk, West Budama ADM2 only), Northern Region (Agago, Aruu, Aswa, Bokora, Chekwii, Chua, Dodoth, Dokolo, Erute, Jie, Kilak, Kioga, Kole, Kwania, Labwor, Lamwo, Maruzi, Matheniko, Moroto, Nwoya, Omoro, Otuke, Oyam, Pian, Pokot ADM2 only))

notes: Uganda in geoBoundaries: ADM1 = 4 regions (Central, Eastern, Northern, Western); ADM2 = 151 old counties (NOT districts); 'Mukono' and 'Soroti' each occur as two distinct ADM2 units and both are included wherever the name is listed. Pop = UBOS 2024 census sub-region totals (Buganda+Kampala, Busoga, Bukedi, Elgon, Teso, Lango, Acholi, Karamoja, Ankole, Bunyoro, Tooro, Rwenzori, Kigezi, West Nile, Madi) assigned to counties by sub-region and scaled to 52.8m (old-sheet WPP basis). Contiguous: Bukedi-Bugisu-Teso-Lango-Acholi-Karamoja (Teso/Lango/Acholi/Karamoja Nilotic blocks plus eastern Bantu groups). notes: Uganda in geoBoundaries: ADM1 = 4 regions (Central, Eastern, Northern, Western); ADM2 = 151 old counties (NOT districts); 'Mukono' and 'Soroti' each occur as two distinct ADM2 units and both are included wherever the name is listed. Rwanda ADM1 = 5 provinces; whole-country seat kept. Pop = old-sheet WPP 2026 basis (14.9m); 2022 census 13.2m. Not clubbed with Burundi/Tanzania/Uganda parts: both are already inside the band.
Burundi ADM1 = 18 provinces; whole-country seat kept. Pop = old-sheet WPP 2026 basis (14.7m); last census 2008, so national-level only.
